outcome: Audit repository memory files and propose targeted, evidence-backed improvements without mutating files before approval.
activation: User asks to check, audit, update, improve, or fix CLAUDE.md files
User mentions CLAUDE.md maintenance or project memory optimization
exclusions: Do not edit CLAUDE.md files when the user only requests an audit
inputs_and_preconditions: Repository or project tree is readable
Read, Glob, Grep, Bash, and Edit capabilities may be available

hard_invariants.description: Find project, local, global, package, and nested CLAUDE.md variants relevant to the repository.
Emit the quality report before making any file mutation.
Obtain user confirmation before applying updates.
Show targeted additions or diffs and preserve existing structure.

decision_points: Classify issues as stale, missing, broken, or undocumented
Ask for approval before applying proposed edits
state: Existing CLAUDE.md content is authoritative input
Edits are applied only after approval
side_effects: Edit CLAUDE.md files only after explicit approval
validation: Documented commands and paths are checked against the repository
failure_recovery: Report unreadable or missing files as gaps
Do not invent commands or apply partial edits silently
